subject: The flight deck of the colony ship ariadne at night, two officers on watch, stars in the big window. Two of the loudest people on the ship on one watch, and you heard them from the corridor. They've scratched a board into a spare console panel and are playing a game with washers, and so far as you can tell each of them is playing by rules the other one made up. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
card: soc.stones, version halloran+waititi (js/content-social-alt.js; tests and effects in js/content-social.js)
notes: A crew photo for one pairing of this card's two leads. The incident is NOT the plain soc scene with faces swapped: this version of the card was rewritten for these two people (title: The Loud Shift). Read the version's text for what must be visible. Quiet, small stakes, nothing has gone wrong yet.
